featured.title: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
featured.tldr: AI scientists produce more original ideas when shown less of the task during generation, and a learned screener then discards half of the candidates while keeping most of the best.

featured.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
featured.tldr: Épi, a persistent research agent with memory, branching and independent review, sets 120 verified records on math constants and constructions and a computer-assisted case of Tuza's conjecture, and its Épi-turbo variant beats Codex on cost.
